steps.note: Lactic and maturation ferments, annatto for colour and rennet go into the vat, with at least two hours of ripening before the rennet.
The curd is cut, washed and stirred.
The curd is cut into blocks and put into moulds.
The wheels are dried to take the moisture off their surface.
The wheels are turned and brushed through months of ageing while mites feed on the rind, pitting it so that air reaches the paste.

sources.text: The steps of Mimolette, a pressed uncooked cheese ripened with Acarus siro mites; the page gives no temperatures or humidity and does not say how the mites are introduced.
